The Star Wars d20 books are the second source of game information after the Legends articles. Their text is copyrighted, so it is kept in <code>Source_Text/</code> on your computer and read through the private book browser, which only works on your own machine: '''[/books Open the source-book browser]''' (search all books, page by page).
